newsitem.title: USA: Wachovia says Q2 includes Year 2000 costs.
newsitem.headline: Wachovia says Q2 includes Year 2000 costs.

text.p: Wachovia Corp on Wednesday reported a $16-million increase in spending in the second fiscal quarter to help rid its computer systems of the "millennium bug."
In posting its earnings performances for the quarter ended June 30, the holding company noted that its results reflected an increase in spending on Year 2000 conversion costs.
Millennium conversion costs refer to money spent to correct computer systems so that they can make date-sensitive calculations after the Year 2000.
The company also noted that its provision for loan losses wa $49.7 million for the quarter, higher by $15.3 from the year-ago period.
